conversations.title: Resolving a disagreement in the team

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think we had a misunderstanding earlier. Let's calm down and talk it through.
lines.text_cz: Myslím, že jsme si dřív nerozuměli. Uklidněme se a probereme to.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're right, we don't always see eye to eye, but I'd like to fix this.
lines.text_cz: Máš pravdu, ne vždy se shodneme, ale chtěl bych to napravit.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I want to apologize for my tone earlier. Can we find a compromise?
lines.text_cz: Chci se omluvit za svůj tón dříve. Můžeme najít kompromis?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, let's find common ground and move forward together.
